scope: Legally accessible, automatable, market-relevant public data. Paywall, CAPTCHA, login bypass, personal data, and sources without stable machine-readable interfaces are out of scope.

causal_clock.published_at: Source publication or revision time when supplied.
causal_clock.model_rule: A feature is visible only to the first decision after available_at; present snapshots are never projected backward.
